cohort: 6900 newborns from rural areas of Kohgiluyeh and Boyerahmad Province, Iran
finding: Consanguinity (specifically marriage to first cousins), prematurity, low birth weight, C-section, birth rank greater than 3, and birth intervals less than 24 months were significantly associated with neonatal mortality.
mod_finding: C-section was significantly associated with neonatal mortality.
